dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many expert‑level nuggets (e.g., ApproveAfterDays counts from patch release, PatchGroup tag case‑sensitivity, AND vs OR in baseline rules, NoReboot semantics, rate‑control necessity). However it omits guidance on SSM Agent version compatibility per OS, does not detail the manual cross‑region baseline replication steps beyond “export/import”, and lacks a concrete note on SSM document versioning pitfalls (e.g., $LATEST vs $DEFAULT).

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Clearly articulates the safety‑first mindset, ordered pre‑checks, CONFIRM gate, snapshot capture, and step‑by‑step CLI plan. Lacks an explicit procedure for handling a failed send‑command (retry policy, rollback beyond snapshot), which is a standard AWS‑specific remediation step.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., NoReboot does not prevent kernel reboot, wrong Patch Group tag, fleet‑wide Install without rate‑control). Lacks a specific anti‑pattern about using $LATEST document versions, which can cause drift.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter, description, when_to_use, activation_triggers, and invocation_schema are all present and well‑formed. The specification could be tighter on “when NOT to invoke” (e.g., explicitly forbid execution on stopped instances) and on required IAM permission sets.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Uses layered sections (quick reference, mindset, pre‑flight, process, anti‑patterns) so the agent sees only needed detail. The OS‑by‑OS matrix and extensive tables are a bit dense, causing some cognitive load before deeper sections.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained with mandatory CONFIRM gate, pre‑checks, snapshot, and rate‑control. Creative tasks (baseline authoring) also have safety checks. Calibration matches task fragility.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a clear, repeatable pattern (What it does → Quick navigation → Mindset → Pre‑flight → Process → Output → Anti‑patterns → Safety). Structure is coherent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete CLI commands, confirmation prompts, and post‑verification steps, enabling an agent to execute end‑to‑end. Missing explicit error‑handling branches for command failures, pagination handling for large fleets, and a detailed retry/back‑off plan for eventual‑consistency delays.
